type finalFrameSink struct {
	payload []byte
}

func (s *finalFrameSink) DeliverNetworkPacket(proto tcpip.NetworkProtocolNumber, pkt *stack.PacketBuffer) {
	b, ok := pkt.Data().PullUp(1)
	if !ok || proto != header.ARPProtocolNumber {
		s.payload = append(s.payload, 0)
		return
	}
	s.payload = append(s.payload, b[0])
}

func (*finalFrameSink) DeliverLinkPacket(tcpip.NetworkProtocolNumber, *stack.PacketBuffer) {
	panic("unexpected link packet")
}

func TestNetgoferFinalFrameBehindEmptyRecords(t *testing.T) {
	fds, err := unix.Socketpair(unix.AF_UNIX, unix.SOCK_SEQPACKET|unix.SOCK_NONBLOCK|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer unix.Close(fds[0])
	defer unix.Close(fds[1])
	closed := make(chan tcpip.Error, 1)
	link, err := fdbased.New(&fdbased.Options{
		FDs: []int{fds[0]}, MTU: 1500, EthernetHeader: true,
		PacketDispatchMode: fdbased.RecvMMsg, ProcessorsPerChannel: 1, DetectSeqpacketEOF: true,
		ClosedFunc: func(err tcpip.Error) { closed <- err },
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer link.Close()
	for range 32 {
		if err := unix.Sendmsg(fds[1], nil, nil, nil, 0); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	frame := make([]byte, header.EthernetMinimumSize+1)
	header.Ethernet(frame).Encode(&header.EthernetFields{DstAddr: header.EthernetBroadcastAddress, Type: header.ARPProtocolNumber})
	frame[len(frame)-1] = 0x5a
	if err := unix.Sendmsg(fds[1], frame, nil, nil, 0); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := unix.Shutdown(fds[1], unix.SHUT_WR); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sink := &finalFrameSink{}
	link.Attach(sink)
	select {
	case err := <-closed:
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("reader stopped with %v", err)
		}
	case <-time.After(3 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("reader still running after 32 empty records, one payload, and peer shutdown")
	}
	link.Wait()
	if !bytes.Equal(sink.payload, []byte{0x5a}) {
		t.Fatalf("got payloads %x, want exactly one 5a", sink.payload)
	}
	t.Log("QUEUE empty=32 delivered=1 marker=5a ended=true")
}
